<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-themes-page.ts. Edit the theme table in packages/core instead. -->

Each family — `ember`, `cobalt`, `verdigris`, `magma`, `brass` — comes in a light and a dark variant.
Name the family and the card carries both, following the viewer's setting; name a variant to
pin it. With no theme, a card wears `ember`.

```text
?username=octocat&theme=cobalt
?username=octocat&theme=cobalt_dark
?username=octocat&theme_light=brass_light&theme_dark=magma_dark
```

The heat is a gradient: its brightest stop to its deepest paints the title, the trail under it,
the rank ring and the corner glow. `title_color` flattens it to one color.

An unknown name is an error, `Incorrect theme input`, rather than a card in the wrong colors.
Any color you pass alongside a theme wins over the theme, so `theme` is a starting point
rather than a lock: see [Common options](../common-options/) for the color params.
